description: `--notify --notifyMode=success` on a failing run under Jest 30.5.2 (B23d A4): a failure sends nothing in this mode, so the fake is never called and `notify.json` is not written. The project's `node_modules/node-notifier/index.js` is a fake that appends each call's options (without the check or stop sign Jest puts before the message on macOS only) to `notify.json`; the icon path is masked. One Jest worker. A black-box run.
